1.5.0: The app is now called OneEditor, and it updates itself: new versions arrive without reinstalling
Type any speed (such as 1.25×), a clip's start time in Audio mode, and any export size (such as 852 × 480)
Export audio as OGG; stretch a picture without cropping; place a picture on another picture
Animation: a transparent stage, and the frame as an SVG picture; a see-through group is no darker where its parts overlap
File ▸ Candidate Details…: every save and export suggests the exam's file name, such as Gas_ZZ999_9999
Help ▸ Report a Problem… saves a report to give your teacher when something goes wrong
